3. Open the Mideo app and start recording. (Notice how your music doesn't pause! If it does, resume the music using your headphones or with Control Center.) 

4. While recording in Mideo, you can use Control Center to restart, resume, or change the song.

—

To record videos WITH the background music in the video, play audio to a speaker. (your device’s built-in speaker or an external speaker) 

To record videos WITHOUT the background music in the video, play audio to headphones.
